units: 1 Unity unit = 1 metre, real-world scale. size_m is the model's largest dimension. The player stands one to three metres from every prop and looks straight at it, so detail at hand scale matters.
camera: First person, fixed standing position in the pilothouse, 68 degree field of view, mouse look. Props are seen from a standing adult's eye height at one to three metres.
style: Realistic game prop, photographic, mid-poly with clean readable forms. One object, complete and uncropped, centred on a plain neutral grey background, lit softly from above and the front, seen square-on from straight in front at eye level, its front face flat to the camera, not turned. Washed-out sun-faded palette cyan appears on nothing else. Real materials with honest wear: fingerprints on brass, chips at the edges of enamel, scuffs on steel. No labels, no lettering.
negative: stylised, cartoon, low-poly, toy, miniature, chibi, voxel, pixel art, sci-fi, fantasy, modern, plastic, glossy, mirror reflections, painted lighting, baked shadows, ground plane, base disc, scenery, background objects, multiple objects, duplicates, cropped, cut off, text, lettering, logos, watermark, people, hands

assets.name: Oilskins on a hook
assets.prompt: A yellow PVC oilskin raincoat hanging limp from a single brass wall hook by its collar loop, with a yellow sou'wester rain hat hung on the same hook above the collar. 1970s fisherman's foul-weather gear, stiff and creased, a little grubby at the hem and cuffs, sleeves hanging straight down, hood lying flat against the back. Seen straight on from the front.
assets.notes: Hangs on the pilothouse wall beside the port door. The slot is 1.3 m from hook to hem, 0.5 m wide. The back is never seen.

assets.name: Ship's wheel
assets.prompt: A ship's steering wheel on its own, 0.6 metres across, with six spokes ending in turned wooden handles, a varnished oak rim with a brass band, and a round brass hub. Seen straight on, the full circle visible, floating alone in empty space with nothing behind it or below it: no stand, no pedestal, no column, no post.
assets.notes: The game spins it about its axis, so the hub must be the centre.

assets.name: Engine order telegraph
assets.prompt: A brass engine order telegraph on a round brass pedestal column with a flared foot, 1.4 metres tall, with a drum-shaped brass head and a single brass handle lever, and a small brass bell on top. The round glass dial face is plain cream enamel, blank, divided into wedge-shaped sectors by thin lines, with no numbers, not a clock. Worn brass, 1950s ship. Seen from the front, the dial face toward the viewer.
assets.notes: The game draws its own pointer on the dial; a plain dial is fine.

assets.name: Compass binnacle
assets.prompt: A ship's magnetic compass binnacle in dulled brass: a tapered round column on a flared base, a drum-shaped head with a low domed hood and a small finial, a small rectangular viewing window on the front of the head, and two dark iron correcting spheres on short arms either side of the head. 1.45 metres tall. Seen from the front.

assets.name: Radar console
assets.prompt: A 1960s ship's radar display console seen exactly from the front: a grey hammertone steel cabinet 0.6 metres wide and 1 metre tall with a row of four black knobs, its top a desk face sloping back holding one large round dark-green glass cathode-ray screen 0.4 metres across under a short black rubber hood. Symmetrical, front face flat to the viewer. No lamp, no gauge, no dial needle.
assets.notes: The game draws the radar picture on its own disc; the scope face should be plain black.

assets.name: Sound-powered telephone
assets.prompt: A ship's sound-powered telephone in a grey-green painted steel wall box 0.36 metres tall, with a black bakelite handset in a cradle on the front, a small brass crank handle on the right side, and a small blank brass plate below the cradle. Chipped paint. Seen straight on from the front.
assets.notes: Mounts on a wall; the back is never seen.

assets.name: VHF radiotelephone
assets.prompt: A 1970s marine VHF radiotelephone set in a dark grey steel case 0.58 metres wide, with a black front panel holding a small blank channel window, two chrome knobs and a row of four square buttons, and a black telephone-style handset on a coiled cord resting on a chrome hook on the left side. Seen from the front.
assets.notes: The game lights the channel window itself.

assets.name: Tabletop AM radio
assets.prompt: A 1960s tabletop AM radio in a walnut veneer wooden case 0.56 metres wide, with a long horizontal blank dial glass across the upper front, a cloth speaker grille below it, and four small black knobs along the bottom edge. Scuffed and well used. Seen from the front.
assets.notes: The game draws the dial scale and pointer on the glass.

assets.name: Swivel stool
assets.prompt: A steel swivel stool 0.85 metres tall with a round brown leatherette seat on a grey painted column and a four-foot base, 1950s workshop style, worn. Seen from the front and slightly above.

assets.name: Life ring
assets.prompt: An orange cork ship's life ring 0.7 metres across with four white canvas bands and a white rope grab line looped around it, a little grubby. Seen straight on, the full ring visible, nothing through the hole.
assets.notes: Hangs flat on the back wall.

assets.name: Port control stand
assets.prompt: A ship's bridge control stand, a mint-green enamelled steel pedestal 0.6 metres wide and 1.1 metres tall with a sloping instrument panel on top facing the viewer: one round brass-bezelled depth gauge with a glass face on the left, and on the right two brass toggle switches and two small round jewelled indicator lamps in brass bezels, small engraved brass label plates under each. Riveted panel edges, a kick plate at the foot. Seen exactly from the front.

assets.name: Gyro compass repeater stand
assets.prompt: A ship's gyro compass repeater on a short pedestal, seen exactly from the front: a round black-painted cast steel housing with a heavy brass bezel ring and flat glass face, tilted back to be read from behind a steering wheel, on a mint-green enamelled steel column 1.1 metres tall with a flared base. The dial face is a plain white compass card with black degree ticks, no numbers.

assets.name: Whistle pull handle
assets.prompt: A carved wooden pull handle for a ship's steam whistle: a turned and hand-carved dark oak grip 15 centimetres long, shaped like a short thick baluster with grooved rings, varnished and worn smooth in the middle, a brass ferrule and brass eye at the top where the pull wire attaches. Hanging vertically. Seen exactly from the front.

assets.name: Pilothouse side door
assets.prompt: A ship's pilothouse side door seen exactly from the front, flat to the viewer: a mint-green enamelled steel door 0.8 metres wide and 1.95 metres tall in a steel frame, a round brass-rimmed porthole window high in the middle, a heavy brass lever handle, six steel dogs around the edge, rubber gasket at the seams, a kick plate at the bottom, chips and handling wear around the handle.

assets.name: Chart table
assets.prompt: A ship's chart cabinet seen exactly from the front at drawer height, the camera level with the top edge so the top surface is not visible: a solid heavy varnished oak plan chest 1.7 metres wide and 0.9 metres tall, a closed front with no knee space, three tiers of wide shallow chart drawers each with two brass cup pulls, a plinth at the foot, a thin brass edge along the top, worn varnish at the corners.
